crime_highlights: you committed the crimes in question in broad daylight, that is the robbery in particular, while apparently sober
The crimes must be regarded as deliberate and calculated.
You wore a mask and no one forced you into the store that you robbed.
You brought fear into the life of an innocent young person, the clerk at the store you robbed.
rationale_highlights: The principal factors, though, that I have to take into account in mitigation in relation to the case before me, Mr. Jeff, relate to your background and circumstances.
I am required by the law to seek a measure of restorative justice, and to temper that sentence in light of the Gladue factors that I have described
considering, in other words, the circumstances of your background that have led you here
note: Residential school mention concerns co-accused Stump; Jeff's own Gladue factors are care and neglect.

crime_highlights: wearing black gloves and carrying a knife, Mr. Sazmand, who was 19, left his family home
He entered M.T.'s ground-floor suite through an unlocked sliding window to burgle her apartment.
M.T. woke up to see him standing in the doorway of her bedroom.
He stood next to her holding the knife, which was approximately 10 to 20 centimetres from her head.
He told her to be silent and not to look at him.
rationale_highlights: the difficult family history and disadvantaged background of Mr. Sazmand
He has moved from country to country due to persecution in his homeland
Mr. Sazmand's age and the real prospect of rehabilitation, reintegration and employment on his release are factors strongly supporting a shorter period of incarceration
note: Refugee background listed only as a mitigating factor; no explicit statement of effect.

crime_highlights: The cause of Isabella's death was blunt force trauma to the abdomen which ruptured her mesentery vein and caused internal bleeding.
Several days before Isabella's death, burn marks were noted on her body.
Mr. Sunshine told Mr. X that he punched Isabella in her stomach on the night in question and had done so approximately 25 times in the past.
He said he did this to discipline her.
Mr. Sunshine also said that he burned Isabella.
rationale_highlights: Mr. Sunshine told the author of the pre-sentence report that his mother had been in the residential school system and had substance abuse problems.
I do take into account Mr. Sunshine's aboriginal status as well as his disadvantaged background.
While that has some impact on the result I reach, given the nature and seriousness of the offence, it is not of great significance.
note: Court says factor has some impact but little significance given seriousness.
